div.head: Ine 55
div.ab: XCIX. Eowu bið mid hire geongan sceape scll' weorð oðþæt XIIII nyht ofer eastran.
XCVIIII. Ewo bið mid hire giunge sceape scill. weorð oþþæt XII niht ofer eastran.
Ouis cum agno suo ualet I solidum usque ad XIIII noctes post pascha.
{XCVIIII} Ewo bið mid hire giunge sceape sciƚƚ weorð oþþæt XII niht ofer eastran.
A ewe with her young sheep is worth a shilling until the twelfth night after Easter.
An ewe with her lamb is worth a shilling, until a fortnight after Easter.
A ewe with her lamb is worth a shilling until 12 days after Easter.
Ein Mutterschaf mit seinem jungen Schafe ist einen Schilling werth bis 12 (14) Tage nach Ostern.
A ewe with her lamb is worth one shilling until 12 (14) days after Easter.
div.note: Nowell’s transcript originally read 12, corrected to 14; later MSS have 14.
